Passengers move between them in soft focus while wind lifts <Subject 2>'s loose hair strands and moves the hem of <Subject 1>'s coat. Neither immediately approaches. The train departure signal sounds. <Subject 2> gently releases his hand first. <Subject 1> steps backward into the train while maintaining eye contact. The doors begin closing between them.
